English: Influence of GST- and P450-based metabolic resistance to pyrethroids on blood feeding in the major African malaria vector Anopheles funestus
Luganda: Okukosa kwa GST- ne P450-based metabolic resistance ku pyrethroids ku kunuuna omusaayi mu Anopheles funestus ng’ekisinga okutambuza omusujja gw’ensiri mu Afirika
Yoruba: Ipa agbára ìtakò àwọn kẹ́míkà agbé-ẹ̀mí-dúró afi-GST- àti P450-pilẹ̀ lórí ìmùjẹ̀ Anofẹ́líìsì fúnẹtọ̀sì kòkòrò agbé-ibà-rìn ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà

Hausa: Tasirin GST- da kuma P450 na tushen juriya na rayuwa ga maganin feshi na pyrethroids a kan shan jini a cikin manyan sauruka masu sa zazzaɓin cizon sauro Anopheles funestus
Northern Sotho: Khuetšo ya GST- le go tlwaela go retelela dihlare go go theilwego godimo ga P450 go pyrethroids go dinwamadi go monang wo o phatlalatšago malaria kudu ka Afrika, e lego Anopheles funestus

English: Insecticide resistance genes are often associated with pleiotropic effects on various mosquito life-history traits.
Luganda: Endagabutonde ezigugubira eddagala eritta ebiwuka zitera okukwanyizibwa n’ebiva ku pleiotropic ku byafaayo by’enneeyisa z’ensiri.
Yoruba: Àwọn jíìnì atako-oró kòkòrò máa ń sábà nííṣe pẹ̀lú nínípa tó pọ̀ lórí àbùdá ìtàn-ìran oríṣiríṣi ẹ̀fọn.
Zulu: Izimpawufuzo zokumelana nezibulalizinambuzane zivamise ukuhlotshaniswa nezinto ezikhiqiza imiphumela eminingi ezimpawini ezahlukene zempilo kamiyane.
Hausa: Ƙwayoyin gado na juriya na maganin ƙwari galibi suna haɗuwa da tasirai fiye da ɗaya a halaye daban-daban na tarihin rayuwar sauro.
Northern Sotho: Ditšini tša go retelela dibolayadikhunkhwane gantši di amana le diabe tša pholeitrophiki go mehuta ya histori ya kgale ya menang ya go fapafapana.
Amharic: ጸረ-ተባይ መድሃኒቶችን የሚቋቋሙ ጂኖች አብዛኛውን ጊዜ በተለያዩ የትንኝ የህይወት ታሪክ ባህሪያት ላይ ካላቸው ፕሊዮትሮፒክ  ተጽእኖ ጋር ይዛመዳሉ፡፡

English: However, very little information is available on the impact of insecticide resistance on blood feeding process in mosquitoes.
Luganda: Wabula, waliwo obubaka butono nnyo ku kukosebwa kw’okugugubira eddagala eritta ebiwuka ku nsiri ezinuuna omusaayi.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ ṣá, ẹnu àlàyé kékeré nìkan ló wà lórí ipa ìtako kòkòrò lórí ìgbésẹ̀ ìmùjẹ̀ nínú àwọn ẹ̀fọn.
Zulu: Nokho, ulwazi oluncane lukhona emtheleleni wokumelana nezibulalizinambuzane emgudwini wokudla igazi.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, bayanai kaɗan ne ake samu a kan tasirin juriyar maganin ƙwari a kan tsarin shan jini a cikin sauruka.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, go hwetšagala tshedimošo ye nnyane kudu ka ga kamego ya go retelela sebolayadikhunkhwane go tshepedišo ya go iphepa ka madi go menang.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በትንኞች የደም አመጋገብ ስርአት ውስጥ የጸረ-ተባይ መድሃኒቶች ተጋትሮ ስላለው ተጽእኖ  የተገኘው መረጃ እጅግ አነስተኛ ነው ፡፡

English: Here, using two recently detected DNA-based metabolic markers in the major malaria vector, An. funestus, we investigated how metabolic resistance genes could affect the blood meal intake.
Luganda: Wano, nga tukozesa metabolic markers ezaakazuulibwa era nga ezeesigamiziddwa ku DNA mu kisinga okutambuza omusujja gw’ensiri An.Funestus twanoonyereza ku ngeri metabolic resistance genes gye ziyinza okukosa ennuuna y’omusaayi ng’emmere.
Yoruba: Níbí, pẹ̀lú ìṣàwárí àwọn agbára ìtakò àwọn kẹ́míkà agbé-ẹ̀mí-dúró afi-DNA-pilẹ̀ lára àwọn kòkòrò agbé-ibà-rìn An.Fúnẹtọ̀sì, a ṣèwádìí bí àwọn jíìnì agbára ìtakò àwọn kẹ́míkà agbé-ẹ̀mí-dúró ṣe lè nípa lórí ouńjẹ ẹjẹ̀.
Zulu: Lapha, kusetsenziswa ama-metabolic marker amabili asanda kutholakala asuselwa kwi-DNA esithuthini esikhulu sikamalaleveva, i-Anopheles funestus, siphenye ukuthi izimpawufuzo ze-metabolic resistance zinomthelela kanjani enanini legazi ngesidlo.
Hausa: A nan, ta yin amfani da alamomi rayuwa biyu na ƙwayar halittar DNA da aka gano kwanan nan a cikin manyan sauruka masu sa zazzaɓin cizon sauro, An. funestus, mun bincika yadda ƙwayoyin gado na juriya na rayuwa za su iya shafar cin abinci na jini.
Northern Sotho: Mo, ka tšhomišo ya maswao a mabedi a methapoliki ao a sa tšwago go lemogwa a go thewa godimo ga DNA go monang wo o phatlalatšago malaria kudu, e lego An. funestus, re dirile diphatišišo mabapi le ka moo ditšini tša methapoliki tša go retelela dihlare di ka amago go iphepa ka madi.
Amharic: እዚህ ጋር ሁለት በዋናው የወባ አስተላላፊ  አ.ኖ ፊኒስተስ ውስጥ በቅርቡ የተገኙ ዲኤንኤ-መር የማብላላት አመላካቾችን በመጠቀም፣የማብላላት ተጋትሮ ያላቸው ጂኖች እንዴት የደም ምግብ ፍጆታ ላይ ተጽእኖ እንደሚያሳድሩ መርምረናል፡፡

English: After allowing both the field F1 and lab F8 Anopheles funestus strains to feed on the human arm for 30 minutes, we assessed the association between key parameters of blood meal process including, probing time, feeding duration, blood feeding success, blood meal size, and markers of glutathione S-transferase (L119F-GSTe2) and cytochrome P450 (CYP6P9a_R)—mediated metabolic resistance.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’okukkiriza field F1 ne lab F8 Anopheles funestus strains okunuuna omusaayi ku mukono gw’omuntu okumala eddakiika 30, twekaliriza obukwatane wakati w’ebiramulirwako omusaayi oguliibwa ng’emmere, omuli ekiseera ky’okunoonya, ebbanga eririirwamu, obusobozi bw’okunuuna omusaayi, obunene bw’omusaayi ogunuuniddwa, ne markers of glutathione S-transferase (L119F-GSTe2) ne cytochrome P450 (CYP6P9a_R)—mediated metabolic resistance.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn ìgbà tí a fi ààyè gba àwọn Anofẹ́líìsì fúnẹtọ̀sì ohun èlò oko ìwádìí F1 àti ti láàbù F8 láti mu ẹ̀jẹ̀ lápá ènìyàn fún ìṣẹ́jú 30, wọn wo ìbáṣepọ̀ tí ó wà láàrin àwọn pàrámítà tó ṣe kókó fún ìgbésẹ mímùjẹ̀, tí ó fi mọ́ àsìkò ìdáru, iye àsìkò ìmùjẹ, àṣeyọrí ìmùjẹ̀, ìwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí ó jẹ́ mímu, àti aṣààmì markers of gilutatìónì S-tiransiferase (L119F-GSTe2) àti sáítókíróòmù P450 (CYP6P9a_R)— agbára ́ ìtakò ti àwọn kẹ́míkà agbé-ẹ̀mí-dúró tí kò fì síbìkan.
Zulu: Ngemva kokuvumela kokubili i-F1 kanye ne-lab F8 Anopheles funestus strains ukuthi idle engalweni yomuntu imizuzu engu-30, sihlole ukuhlobana phakathi kwemingcele ebalulekile yenqubo yokudla kwegazi okuhlanganisa, isikhathi sokuhlola, ubude besikhathi sokudla, impumelelo yokondla igazi, ubukhulu bokudla kwegazi, kanye izimpawu ze-glutathione S-transferase (L119F-GSte2) kanye ne-cytochrome P450 (CYP6P9a_R) -ukumelana nokusetshenziswa kwe-metabolic.
Hausa: Bayan barin duka Anopheles funestus na fili F1 da na ɗakin gwaji F8 shan jinin hannunn ɗan’adam na tsawon mintoci 30, mun tantance alaƙa tsakanin mahimman sigogin tsarin abinci na jini wanda ya haɗa da, lokacin tabbatarwa da tsawon lokacin ciyarwa da nasarar shan jini da yawan jini, da kuma alamomin glutathione S-transferase (L119F-GTe2) da kuma cytochrome P450 (CYP6P9a_R) —matsakaiciyar juriyar rayuwa.
Northern Sotho: Morago ga go dumelela bobedi mehuta tša field F1 le lab F8 Anopheles funestus gore di iphepe ka letsogo la motho tekano ye metsotso ye 30, re lekotše kamano magareng ga mellwane ye bohlokwa ya tshepedišo ya go nwa madi go akaretša, nako ya go phuruphutša, nako ya go iphepa, dikatlego tša go iphepa ka madi, bogolo bja madi a nwelwego, le maswao a glutathione S-transferase (L119F-GSTe2) le saethokheroumu ya P450 (CYP6P9a_R)—ye e hlohleletšwago ke go itlwaetša go retelela dihlare.
Amharic: ሁለቱንም የፊልድ F1 እና የላብራቶሪ F8 የአኖፌሊስ ፈኒስተስ ዝርያዎች በሰው ክንድ ላይ ለ30 ደቂቃ እንዲመገቡ ከፈቀድን በኋላ ፣የደም አመጋገብ ሂደት ቁልፍ መለኪያዎችን ማለትም፣የመመርመሪያ ጊዜ፣የአመጋገብ ቆይታ ፣የደም አመጋገብ ስኬታማነት፣የደም ምግብ መጠን፣እና የግሉታቲዮን ኤስ-ትራንስፈሬዝ አመላካቾችን (L119F-GSTe2) እና በሳይቶክሮም P450 (CYP6P9a_R) የተቀናጀ የማብላላት ተጋትሮ መካከል ያለውን  ዝምድና ገምግመናል፡፡

English: None of the parameters of blood meal process was associated with L119F-GSTe2 genotypes.
Luganda: Tewali na kimu ku biramulirwako musaayi guliibwa ng’emmere kyakwanyizibwa na L119F-GSTe2 genotypes.
Yoruba: Kò sí Kankan nínú àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ ẹ̀jẹ̀ mímu yìí tí ó nííṣe pẹ̀lú ẹ̀jẹ̀ L119F-GSTe2.
Zulu: Ayikho kula mapharamitha omgudu wesidlo segazi ahlotshaniswa nokubukeka kwe-L119F-GSTe2.
Hausa: Babu ɗaya daga cikin ma’auni na tsarin abinci na jini da ke da alaƙa da nau’o’in ƙwayoyin gado na mutum L119F-GTe2.
Northern Sotho: Ga go le e tee ya mellwane ya tshepedišo ya go iphepa ka madi ye e bego e amantšhwa le ditlhamegotšini tša L119F-GSTe2.
Amharic: የትንኞቹም የደም አመጋገብ ሂደት መለኪያዎች ከ L119F-GSTe2  የጂን አወቃቀር ጋር አልተያያዙም ነበር፡፡

English: By contrast, for CYP6P9a_R, homozygous resistant mosquitoes were significantly more able to blood-feed than homozygous susceptible (OR = 3.3; CI 95%: 1.4–7.7; P = 0.01) mosquitoes.
Luganda: Mu kugeraageranya, CYP6P9a_R, homozygous resistant mosquitoes zaali zisobolera ddala okunuuna omusaayi okusinga ensiri ez’kika kya homozygous susceptible (OR = 3.3; CI 95%: 1.4–7.7; P = 0.01) mosquitoes.
Yoruba: Ní ìyàtọ̀, fún CYP6P9a_R, àwọn ẹ̀fọn atako homosígíọ̀sì pẹ̀lú ìyàtọ̀ tó lápẹẹrẹ lè mu ẹ̀jẹ̀ ju àwọn ẹ̀fọn agba homosígíọ̀sì lọ (OR = 3.3; CI 95%: 1.4–7.7; P = 0.01).
Zulu: Ngokuphambene, ku-CYP6P9a_R, omiyane abamelene ne-homozygous babekwazi kakhulu ukudla igazi kune-homozygous susceptible (NOMA = 3.3; CI 95%: 1.4-7.7; P = 0.01) omiyane.
Hausa: Saɓanin haka, don CYP6P9a_R, sauruka masu juriyar magungunan ƙwari sun fi ƙarfin shan jini fiye da sauruka masu saurin kamuwa (OR = 3.3; CI 95%: 1.4-7.7; P = 0.01).
Northern Sotho: Go thulana le se, go CYP6P9a_R, menang ya homosaekase ya go retelela sehlare e be e kgona go iphepa ka madi ka tsela ye e makatšago go feta menang ya homosaekase ye e lego kotsing (OR = 3.3; CI 95%: 1.4–7.7; P = 0.01).
Amharic: በአንጻሩ ለሆሞዛይጎስ ተጋላጭ (OR= 3.3; CI 95%: 1.4–7.7፤ P = 0.01) ከሆኑት ትንኞች ይልቅ የCYP6P9a_R ሆሞዛይጎስ ተቋቋሚ ትንኞች በእጅጉ የበለጠ የደም-ምግብ መመገብ ችለዋል ፡፡

English: Moreover, the volume of blood meal ingested by CYP6P9a-SS mosquitoes was lower than that of CYP6P9a-RS (P<0.004) and of CYP6P9a-RR (P<0.006).
Luganda: N’ekirala, obungi bw’omusaayi ogwanuunibwa ensiri CYP6P9a-SS gwali wansi okusinga ogwo ogwa CYP6P9a-RS (P<0.004) n’ogwa CYP6P9a-RR (P<0.006).
Yoruba: Ju gbogbo ẹ, iye ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí àwọn ẹ̀fọn CYP6P9a-SS mu kéré sí ti CYP6P9a-RS (P<0.004) àti CYP6P9a-RR ((P<0.006).
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthamo wokudla kwegazi ofakwe omiyane be-CYP6P9a-SS wawuphansi kunalowo we-CYP6P9a-RS (P<0.004) kanye ne-CYP6P9a-RR (P<0.006).
Hausa: Haka kuma, adadin abincin jinin da sauruka CYP6P9a-SS suka ci ya yi ƙasa da na CYP6P9a-RS (P<0.004) da kuma na CYP6P9a-RR (P<0.006).
Northern Sotho: Go feta fao, kelo ya madi ao a nwelwego ke menang ya CYP6P9a-SS e bile ya fase ga menang ya CYP6P9a-RS (P<0.004) le ya CYP6P9a-RR (P<0.006).
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በ CYP6P9a-SS ትንኞች የተወሰደው የደም መጠን ከCYP6P9a-RS (P<0.004) እና ከCYP6P9a-RR (P<0.006) ይልቅ ያነሰ ነበር፡

English: This suggests that CYP6P9a gene is inked with the feeding success and blood meal size of An. funestus.
Luganda: Kino kitulaga nti akalagabutonde CYP6P9a keekwanya ku bungi bw’omusaayi ogunuunibwa ng’emmere mu An. funestus.
Yoruba: Èyí dá a lábàá pé jíìnì CYP6P9a so mọ́ ìkésẹjárí mímu àti ìwọ̀n oúnjẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ An.Fúnẹtọ̀sì.
Zulu: Lokhu kukhomba ukuthi uphawufuzo i-CYP6P9a luxhumene nokuphumela ukudla kanye nesidlo segaiz se-An funestus.
Hausa: Wannan yana nuna cewa CYP6P9a an alaƙanta shi tare da nasarar ciyarwa da girman abincin An. funestus.
Northern Sotho: Se se šišinya gore tšini ya CYP6P9a e amana le katlego ya go iphepa le bogolo bja madi ao a nwewago ke An. funestus.
Amharic: ይህ CYP6P9a ጂን ከአ.ኖ ፈኒስተስ የአመጋገብ ስኬት እና ከደም ምግብ መጠን ጋር እንደሚያያዝ ያሳያል፡፡

English: However, no correlation was found in the expression of CYP6P9a and that of genes encoding for salivary proteins involved in blood meal process.
Luganda: Wabula, tewali bukwatane bwazuulibwa mu neeyoeleka ya CYP6P9a n’obulagabutonde obwoleka salivary proteins ezibeera mu nnuuna y’omusaayi gw’emmere.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ ṣá, kò sí ìjọra tí a rí nínú ìṣesí CYP6P9a àti ti àwọn jíìnì tí ó kórajọ fún ìpèsẹ̀ itọ́ inú èròjà amáradàgbà ní ó ń jẹyọ nínú ouńjẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀.
Zulu: Nokho, akukho ukuhlobana okutholakele ekubhalweni kwe-CYP6P9a kanye nalokhu kokuqoshwa kwezimpawufuzo kwizakhamzimba zamathe ezibandakanyekayo emgudwini yesidlo segazi.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, ba a sami alaƙa ba a cikin bayanin CYP6P9a da na ƙwayoyin gado da ke ɓoyewa don furotocin yawu da suke cikin tsarin abinci na jini.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, ga se gwa hwetšwa kamano go tlhagišo ya CYP6P9a le ya tlwaetšo ya ditšini go diprotheine tša mareng tše di amegago go tshepedišo ya go iphepa ka madi.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ በ CYP6P9a መገለጫ እና የደም ምግቡ ስርአት ውስጥ ተሳታፊ በሆኑት በምራቅ ውስጥ ባሉ ፕሮቲኖች የጂን ኮድ አደራረግ ጋር ምንም አይነት ዝምድና አልተገኘም፡፡

English: This study suggests that P450-based metabolic resistance may influence the blood feeding process of Anopheles funestus mosquito and consequently its ability to transmit malaria parasites.

English: Some malarial mosquitoes have adapted to resist harmful chemicals meant to kill them (insecticides).
Luganda: Ensiri z’omusujja gw’ensiri ezimu zifunye engeri y’okugumira eddagala eritta ebiwuka (insecticides).
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀fọn agbébàrìn ti faramọlé sí àwọn kẹ́míkà atakò tí ó yẹ kí ó pa wọ́n (apakòkòrò).
Zulu: Abanye omiyane bakamalaleveva sebeguquke ukumelana amakhemikhali ayingozi enzelwe ukubabulala (izibulalizinambuzane).
Hausa: Wasu sauruka masu sa zazzaɓin cizon sauro sun daidaita don jurewa sinadarai masu cutarwa don kashe su (magunguna ƙwari).
Northern Sotho: Menang ye mengwe ye e phatlalatšago malaria e atlegile go retelela dikhemikhale tše kotsi tše di diretšwego go e bolaya (dibolayadikhunkhwane).

English: Researchers say the genetic changes driving this “insecticide resistance” in Anopheles funestus mosquitoes, also seems to help them feed better on human blood.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti enkyukakyuka mu bulagabutonde ezikola ku “bugugubi bw’eddagala eritta ebiwuka” mu nsiri Anopheles funestus, nazo ziziyamba okunuuna obulungi omusaayi mu bantu.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sọ pé ìyípadà ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìran tí ó ń fa “ìtako apakòkòrò” nínu ẹ̀fọń Anopheles funestus, tún ń ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti lè jẹun síi lára ènìyàn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi inguqukofuzo kwimiyane yohlobo lwe-Anopheles funestus nokuyiyo eyimbangela yokukwazi ukumelana nesibulala zinambuzane kwalemiyane, ibukeka iphinde iyisize futhi le miyane ekutheni ikwazi ukumunca kangcono igazi labantu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sauye-sauyen ƙwayoyin gado da suke haifar da wannan "jurewar maganin ƙwari" a cikin sauruka Anopheles funestus, kuma da alama yana taimaka musu su shan jinin ɗan’adam sosai.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore diphetogo tša ditlhamegotšini tše di hlohleletšago “go retelela dibolayadikhunkhwane” go menang ya Anopheles funestus, le tšona di bonala di e thuša go iphepa ka bokaone ka madi a batho.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በአኖፌሊስ ፈኒስተስ ትንኞች ውስጥ የሚገኙት ይህን የጸረ-ተባይ መድሃኒት ተጋትሮ የሚያመጡት የጄኔቲክ ለውጦች፣ የሰዎችን ደም በበለጠ እንዲመገቡ ሳያስችላቸው አልቀረም ይላሉ፡፡

English: This in turn may increase their ability to spread malaria.
Luganda: Kino era kisobola okwongeza obusobozi bwazo okusaasaanya omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Àbọ̀ èyí lè ṣàlékún agbára wọn láti lè tan ibà ká.
Zulu: Lokhu kwenza le miyane ikwazi ukusabalalisa umalaleveva kalula.
Hausa: Wannan kuma yana iya ƙara musu ƙarfin yaɗa cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Se se ka feleletša se oketša bokgoni bja yona go phatlalatša malaria.
Amharic: ይህ በምላሹ ወባን የማሰራጨት አቅማቸውን ሊጨምረው ይችላል፡፡

English: Certain malarial mosquitoes are able to resist the deadly effect of insecticides by better metabolising, or processing, these chemicals within their bodies.
Luganda: Ezimu ku nsiri z’omusujja zisobola okugumira obukambwe bw’eddagala eritta ebiwuka nga zikola bulungi ku ddagala lino mu mibiri gyazo.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀fọn kan ní agbára àti lè tako ìgbẹ̀mí inú apakòkòrò pẹ̀lú ìṣàmúlò kẹ́míkà agbẹ́mìídúró, tí yóò ṣiṣẹ́ lórí àwọn kẹ́míka náà nínú ara wọn.
Zulu: Ezinye izinhlobo zemiyane efafaza umalaleveva ziyakwazi ukumelana okanye ukulwisana nezibulala zinambuzane eziyingozi kakhulu ngokuthi zihluze amakhemikhali emzimbeni yayo.
Hausa: Wasu sauruka masu sa zazzaɓin cizon sauro suna iya jurewa mummunan tasirin maganin ƙwari ta hanyar ingantaccen narkewa, ko sarrafa, waɗannan sinadarai a cikin jikinsu.
Northern Sotho: Menang ye mengwe ye e phatlalatšago malaria e kgona go retelela ditlamorago tše šoro tša dibolayadikhunkhwane ka go itlwaetša, goba go amogela, dikhemikhale tše ka mebeleng ya yona.
Amharic: አንዳንድ የወባ ትንኞች እነዚህን ኬሜካሎች በሰውነታቸው ውስጥ በተሻለ ሁኔታ በማብላላት ወይም በመፍጨት የጸረ-ተባይ መድሃኒቶቹን ገዳይ ጉልበት መቋቋም ይችላሉ፡፡

English: This type of resistance to insecticides is driven by genetic adaptations, but not much is known about what other advantages mosquitoes might have because of these same genetic adaptations.
Luganda: Okuguguba okw’engeri eno eri eddagala eritta ebiwuka kuva ku bulagabutonde okumanyiira, naye nga tekimanyiddwa oba nga waliwo ebintu ebirala ensiri bye zirina olw’okumanyiira okw’engeri eyo okujjira ku bulagabutonde.
Yoruba: Irú àwọn ìtakò yìí sí àwọn apakòkòrò ń di fífàsíṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú ìfaramọlé ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìran, ṣùgbọ́n kò sí ohun púpọ̀ tí a mọ̀ nípa àwọn àǹfààní mìíràn tí ẹ̀fọn lè ní nítorí ìfaramọlé ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìran yìí kan náà.
Zulu: Lolu hlobo lokukwazi ukumelana nezibulala zinambuzane kubangelwa ukujwayela izakhi zofuzo kepha okuningi kakwaziwa mayelana nokuthi iyiphi enye inzuzo le miyane engaba nayo ngenxa yokukwazi kwayo ukuthi ijwayele izakhi zofuzo lwezibulala zinambuzane.
Hausa: Wannan nau’in juriya ga maganin ƙwari yana faruwa ne ta hanyar daidaitawar ƙwayoyin gado, amma ba a san da yawa game da abubuwan da saurukan za su samu ba saboda irin wannan daidaitawar ƙwayoyin gado iri ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Mohuta wo wa go retelela dibolayadikhunkhwane o kgontšhwa ke mehuta ya ditlhamegotšini, eupša ga go tsebje kudu ka ga mehola ye mengwe yeo menang e ka bago le yona ka lebaka la mehuta ya yona ye e swanago ya ditlhamegotšini.
Amharic: ይህ አይነቱ ጸረ-ተባይ መድሃኒቶችን የመቋቋም ችሎታ በጄኔቲክ መላመዶች የሚመራ ነው፤ነገር ግን በእነዚሁ ተመሳሳይ የጄኔቲክ መላመዶች ምክንያት ትንኞቹ ያገኙት ሌላ ምን ጥቅም እንዳለ ብዙም የታወቀ ነገር የለም፡፡

English: In this study, researchers wanted to find out if the genes behind metabolic insecticide resistance might also improve their feeding process.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okuzuula oba ng’endabutonde eziri emabega w’okugumira eddagala eritta ebiwuka biyinza okuyamba mu ngeri gye ziryamu.
Yoruba: Ní inú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ wádìí bóyá jíìnì tó wà nídìí agbára ìtako apakòkòrò ti àwọn kẹ́míkà agbé-ẹ̀mí-dúró le mú ìdàgbàsókè bá ìgbésẹ̀ ìmùjẹ wọn.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuthola ukuthi ngabe ufuzo olutholakala ekuhluzeni amakhemikhali ukuze ikwazi ukumelana nezibulala zinambuzane kungenzeka yini lukwazi ukuyilekelela ekutheni ithuthukise indlela edla ngayo le miyane.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su gano ko ƙwayoyin gado da suke haifar da juriyar maganin ƙwari na iya inganta tsarin ciyar da su.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka utolla ge e ba ditšini tše di kgontšhago go itlwaetša go retelela dibolayadikhunkhwane di ka kaonafatša mekgwa ya tšona ya go iphepa.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ ከዚህ ጸረ-ተባይ መድሃኒቶችን በማብላላት ከሚመጣ ተጋትሮ ጀርባ ያሉት ጂኖች የአመጋገብ ሂደታቸውንም አሻሽለው እነደሆነ ማወቅ ይፈልጋሉ፡፡

English: They wanted to know, for instance, if these resistant mosquitoes were able to feed quicker and take in more blood during their meal.
Luganda: Okugeza, baayagala okumanya oba ng’ensiri ezo engugubi zaali zisibola okulya amangu era n’okunuuna omusaayi ogusingako mu kiseera kyazo ekyokulya.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fẹ́ mọ̀, bí àpẹẹrẹ, bóyá àwọn ẹ̀fọn alátakò yìí lè yára mùjẹ̀ tàbí mùjẹ̀ lọ́pọ̀ síi lásìkò oúnjẹ-jíjẹ wọn.
Zulu: Bebefuna ukwazi, ngokwesibonelo, ukuthi ngabe le miyane ekwazi ukumelana nesibulala zinambuzane iyakwazi yini ukudla ngokushesha, munce igazi eliningi kunokwejwayelekile ngesikhathi idla.
Hausa: Suna so su sani, alal misali, idan waɗannan sauruka masu juriya sun iya cin abinci da sauri da kuma shan jini sosai yayin cin abinci.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba nyaka go tseba, mohlala, ge e ba menang ye ya go retelela sehlare e be e kgona go iphepa ka lebelo le go nwa madi a mantši nakong yeo e swerwego ke tlala.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ እነዚህ የመቋቋም ችሎታ ያላቸው ትንኞች በምግብ መመገቢያቸው ጊዜ  በፍጥነት መመገብ እና ተጨማሪ ብዙ ደም መውሰድ ይችሉ እንደሆነ ለማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

English: The researchers looked at how two different strains of Anopheles funestus mosquitoes fed on a human arm for 30 minutes.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baatunuulira engeri ensiri ez’ebika ebibiri ebya Anopheles funestus gye zaanuuna omusaayi ku mukono gw’omuntu okumala eddakiika 30.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà wo bí àwọn oríṣìí ẹ̀fọn Anofẹ́líìsì fúnẹtọ̀sì méjì ṣe mùjẹ̀ ní apá èèyàn fún ìṣẹ́jú 30.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babheke ukuthi ngabe lezi zinhlobo zemiyane i-Anopheles funestus zidla kanjani bebheka indlela ezidla ngayo engalweni yomuntu esikhathini esingangemzuzu engama-30.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun duba yadda mabambanta nau’o'in saurukan Anopheles funestus guda biyu suke cin abinci a hannun ɗan’adam na tsawon mintoci 30.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lekodišišitše ka moo mehuta tše pedi tša go fapafapana tša menang ya Anopheles funestus di iphepilego ka gona ka letsogo la motho metsotso ye 30.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሁለት የተለያዩ የአኖፌሊስ ፈኒስተስ ትንኝ አይነቶች በሰው ክንድ ላይ ለ30 ደቂቃ እንዴት እንደሚመገቡ አስተውለዋል፡፡

English: They measured aspects of the blood meal process, such as for how long the mosquitoes fed and how much blood they extracted.
Luganda: Baapima ebikwata ku nnuuna yaazo ey’omusaayi ng’emmere, gamba ng’ebbanga ensiri lye zaamala nga zirya n’obungi bw’omusaayi gwe zaanuuna.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wọn apá ìgbéṣẹ oúnjẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀, bí ó ṣe pé tó láti mu ẹ̀jẹ̀ àti iye ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí ó fà.
Zulu: Babe sebekala ukuthi le miyane ilidla kanjani igazi bebheka ukuthi idle isikhathi esingakanani futhi lingakanani igazi ekwaze ukulimunca le miyane.
Hausa: Sun kuma auna sassan tsarin cin abinci na jini, kamar tsawon lokacin da sauruka suke shan jini da kuma ywan jinin da suka zuƙa.
Northern Sotho: Ba etše dintlha tša tshepedišo ya go iphepa ka madi, tše bjalo ka ke nako e kaakang menang e iphepa ka madi ao a di a gogilego.
Amharic: የደም ምግብ ሂደቶቹን ገጽታ ማለትም ትንኞቹ ለምን ያህል ጊዜ እንደተመገቡ እና ምን ያህል ደም እንደመጠጡ ለክተዋል፡፡

English: They also analysed the genetics of the mosquitoes to see if different feeding behaviour could be linked to two particular gene mutations that confer insecticide resistance.
